benchmark: PCOE Effect-Owner Payment TLA-to-Scenario Coverage Map
semantics: bounded_modelled means the TLA state model includes the named safety property; partially_modelled means only a simplified abstract component is present; not_in_model means the scenario remains contract-only. None of these labels means the scenario ran against Rust, Holochain, Treasury or an external rail.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Models at-most-one sender and recipient effect under exact retry; does not model the actual ActionHash returned to the caller.
scenarios.next_qualification: Rust history-reducer replay using the original owner ActionHashes.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Models that a changed fingerprint marks conflict without mutating effects; canonical field hashing is not executed by TLA.
scenarios.next_qualification: Rust canonical-intent digest known-answer and mutation tests.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Models a chain-head-moved observation and bounded retry count, but not two concurrent invocations, a real host source-chain race, or a scheduler/history interleaving.
scenarios.next_qualification: Two-agent / one-agent concurrent Holochain Sweettest plus history checker.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Alternate agent keys, DID-to-key authority, clone/recovery identity and capability possession are not state variables in this model.
scenarios.next_qualification: Identity / authority integrity tests and adversarial multi-agent Holochain test.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Models the payer intent/debit as one abstract transition and proves a split-write mutant violates the invariant; does not execute Holochain rollback.
scenarios.next_qualification: Real Finance zome-call failure injection and committed source-chain read-back.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: The model does not create a Treasury effect before a sender commit or model Finance abort afterward; the unsafe cross-cell ordering is described only by the scenario contract.
scenarios.next_qualification: Conductor-level Finance/Treasury call-order test with injected Finance abort after Treasury success.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Models sender commit followed by lost response and recovery; it abstracts returned action references.
scenarios.next_qualification: Replay the exact sender operation against durable source-chain records after response loss/restart.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: There is no request-delivery / pre-commit response-loss variable; the model begins with a locally prepared intent.
scenarios.next_qualification: Fault-injected caller/host harness proving same-key resolution before or after commit.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Models durable fee liability/outbox and Pending/Unknown state; it does not simulate real Treasury unavailability or transport errors.
scenarios.next_qualification: Treasury adapter idempotency test under unavailable/restarted cell.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Models one delivery count after Unknown reconciliation, but not duplicated Treasury deliveries, exact receipt signatures or provider response correlation.
scenarios.next_qualification: Treasury same-idempotency receipt and replay tests, including success-before-response-loss.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Models client cache expiry while the operation tombstone persists; no actual long-retention storage or garbage-collection implementation.
scenarios.next_qualification: Persistence/recovery test across database retention and migration.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Models loss of volatile cache state and durable identity, but not a process/conductor restart, disk recovery or crash consistency.
scenarios.next_qualification: Restart a real Finance conductor after commit and reconcile the original ActionHashes.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: DHT partitions, gossip delay, stale remote views and authoritative owner-chain query availability are not represented.
scenarios.next_qualification: Multi-agent partition/gossip test; missing DHT links must yield Indeterminate.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Models chain-head movement and a recipient fork freeze separately; does not model source-chain fork recovery, restored clones or competing authoritative payer histories.
scenarios.next_qualification: Real fork/restore/recovery test with owner-authority resolution and branch evidence.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Actual integer values, fee arithmetic, overflow, asset denomination and conservation sums are outside the state-count model.
scenarios.next_qualification: FIN-SAFE property tests and checked-integer arithmetic proof over principal, fee, liability and credit.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Models projection cardinalities in the state, but no replay/rebuild worker or duplicate projection event is represented.
scenarios.next_qualification: Independent projection reducer replay and idempotent projector tests over repeated event histories.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Authenticated agent key, author-to-DID mapping and recipient-author verification are not modeled as state variables.
scenarios.next_qualification: Integrity-layer author-binding and owner-capability tests with alternate-key negative controls.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: No external rail, reserve/custody, legal acceptance or physical delivery state is represented.
scenarios.next_qualification: External evidence adapter and finality-boundary tests; internal SAP events must never imply external finality.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Models loss of a post_commit wake-up and rediscovery of a durable outbox item; no real scanner, scheduling or persistence implementation is executed.
scenarios.next_qualification: Restart-safe outbox dispatcher integration test with duplicate dispatch and exact Treasury receipt.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Models chain-head movement count and retry preserving effect counts, but not a real concurrent invocation schedule or actual record re-read.
scenarios.next_qualification: Concurrent Holochain source-chain test and history-based linearizability checker.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Models recipient claim/credit commit followed by response loss and later observation; ActionHash authentication and durable DHT resolution are abstracted.
scenarios.next_qualification: Beneficiary-authored claim Sweettest with lost response and exact ActionHash reconciliation.

scenarios.model_scope_limit: Models a competing recipient successor causing Conflicted and non-spendability; it abstracts actual sibling source chains and conflict-resolution evidence.
scenarios.next_qualification: Tryorama/Sweettest with two signed recipient successors from one predecessor and recovery/freeze assertions.
